items.q: What did the 20-email filter actually cost?
items.a: Jev: 3.41 seconds, about 1 cent per 1,000 emails. Astra: 9.93 seconds, just under $5. The cold open's 400× is the vendor hook. This card is the measurement.
Language. He says Astra is built for that and Jev is not. Yes/no, a preloaded choice, or a score from 1 to 100. [[system-one-model]].

items.q: How does he wire Jev to Astra?
items.a: [[thin-llm-slot-replacement]]. Rules plus a free skill. Jev decides. Astra or Fable 5.1 writes. Beginners call Jev through OpenRouter.

items.q: Why run it on every post?
items.a: Slop Monster is a keep-or-drop. Four cents on his illustrative run. A frontier call is too expensive to put on each item.
